meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成叙事性摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把项目聊天记录整理成每周故事式摘要。
copy.tagline_en: Generate weekly narrative digests of project history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn project chat logs into weekly story-like summaries.

howto.what: 把项目的工作记录按周切开,每周生成一章故事,后一章接着前一章的结尾写,最终产出一部连贯的周记式项目史。
howto.when: 当你说出「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」等关键词,要求把项目历史写成按周连载的章节时触发。

say.text: 把[项目名]的历史写成按周连载的故事。
say.note: 先按周切分时间线,再逐周生成章节。

say.text: 从第一周开始,每周一章,写到最近一周。
say.note: 会从第一周起依次生成所有章节。

say.text: 接着上一章的结尾,继续写下一周的章节。
say.note: 会承接上一周的保留内容,保持连贯。

howto.what_en: Splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files and generates one narrative chapter per week, each continuing from the previous week's carry-forward block, to produce a serial, week-by-week project story.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', etc., or requests a serial week-by-week narrative of a project's history.

say_en.text: Write this project's history as a week-by-week serial story.
say_en.note: Splits the timeline into weeks, then writes chapters.

say_en.text: Start from the first week and produce one chapter per week up to the latest.
say_en.note: Chapters are generated in order, each building on the last.

say_en.text: Continue from last week's ending and write the next chapter.
say_en.note: Picks up from the carry-forward block of the previous week.
